function.description: Use when data in a sqlite/db file (`.db` / `.sqlite` / `.sqlite3`) can be answered with read-only SQL queries or aggregations. Call inspect_sqlite_schema first for an unknown database. do NOT call on `.csv` / `.json` / `.md` / `.txt` paths.
function.name: execute_context_sql

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return.

path.description: Relative path to the sqlite/db file. Examples: 'db/clinical.sqlite', 'main.db'. Paths are relative to the task context directory; DO NOT prepend 'context/'. For example use 'knowledge.md' or 'csv/foo.csv', not 'context/knowledge.md'.
